subject: Chemistry
b6_reason: Protonated secondary alcohol loses water to give a secondary carbocation; a 1,2-hydride shift from the adjacent CH(CH3) carbon converts it to the more stable tertiary carbocation, which Br- traps to give 2-bromo-2-methylbutane.
b6_working: CH3-CH(CH3)-CH(OH)-CH3 + HBr -> CH3-CH(CH3)-CH(+)-CH3 (2 degree cation) -> hydride shift -> CH3-CH2-C(+)(CH3)-CH3 (3 degree cation) -> + Br- -> CH3-CH2-C(Br)(CH3)-CH3
